Review Feedback (`REQUEST_CHANGES`): Your bitwise expression `((seq - 1) & ~63) + 63` fails at `seq = 64` (`63 != 127`). Provide an expression that satisfies both `seq = 63 -> 63` and `seq = 64 -> 127`.

In `src/quant_execution_guard.py`, reading `candles[i + 1]['close']` at decision index `i` introduces future look-ahead bias that invalidates live Forex/Equities execution, and returning `float('inf')` on zero equity bypasses margin risk controls.
